title: Explicit expressive axes

domain.defaultBehavior: each axis independently overrides the experience composition; an unset axis falls back to it, then to baseline

compatibility: closed per-axis vocabularies; both compilers sanitize fail-closed; unset-to-rollback per axis

normalizedStops.law: STATIC ARM ONLY, NOT RECEIPTED (F4B-8/W-A/W-B law, same structural limit already measured in F4B-13/14/15: a single-arm run cannot pass this evidence kind). bithire authors `expressive.profiles.type: 'humanist'` literally (const EXPRESSIVE, bithire/index.ts:3218-3225, an explicit inversion of its selected experience profile's own 'technical' posture -- the source comment names the art-direction reasoning directly: 'a people product, not an instrument'). rottay and evnto author NO expressive axis overrides at all -- both have `expressive: {status: 'unassigned', reason: 'pending-selection'}` in their own CAPABILITIES ledger (grep-confirmed), so neither has an identity for ANY axis of this control.

STATIC ARM ONLY, NOT RECEIPTED (same law as bithire-type/identity above). bithire authors `expressive.profiles.geometry: 'rounded'` literally (const EXPRESSIVE, bithire/index.ts:3226-3233 -- the source comment explains this was chosen specifically to NOT collide with the sibling vertical's own 'soft' posture, and is deliberately distinct from the recipe-profile's own button-shape axis, a different control).

calibration.negativeControlsScopeNote: `border remains fixed` is deliberately NOT declared for this control at all (measured, not assumed): the vocabulary phrase bundles border-width/style AND border-radius into ONE property list (negative-controls/vocabulary.json), and TWO of this control's own 6 axes legitimately move part of that list -- `edge` moves border-width/style, `geometry` moves border-radius (measured directly: pill-accented tripped `negativeControlsHeld: false` on rottay before this fix, citing border-top-left-radius etc.). No narrower 'width/style-only, no radius' or 'radius-only, no width/style' phrase exists in the closed vocabulary (unlike surfaces.elevation-posture's own border narrowing, which only ever touches width/style). Declaring it for the other 4 axes only would need a per-stop override the manifest schema does not carry (same class of gap as domain.bounds per-member, F4B-13). Omitting it entirely is the honest choice: this control legitimately reaches border geometry through 2 of its own 6 members, so a control-level 'border remains fixed' claim would be false for those two and misleading by omission for the rest.
calibration.measuredChannelUnion: Measured directly (compileBrandTheme, isolated single-axis patches, all 3 verticals, every catalog value -- F4B-16), NOT guessed: the union of channels each axis actually moves is far larger than the 6 representative channels in declaredOutputs. type: 8 (--ds-table-header-letter-spacing/-text-transform, --ds-select-group/-menu-group/-page-header-eyebrow-text-transform, --ds-type-display/-label-letter-spacing, --ds-type-numeric-font-variant-numeric -- --ds-type-label-text-transform, claimed by the PRE-F4B-16 registry, does NOT move: measured zero-diff across all 3 verticals and all 4 type values, the static path's role-text-transform channels are written by setSemanticTypographyVariables's own overlay, not by this expansion's direct output). geometry: 35 (cascades through the shared --ds-radius-*/--ds-*-radius surface geometry feeds via fieldDefaults.buttonStyle/radiusScale -- shape.button-style/shape.radius-scale's OWN channels, not this control's; declared here for causal-proof purposes only, ownership stays with those controls, same law F4B-14 applied to typography.families/pairing's shared base/heading channels). edge: 6 (--ds-edge-hairline-width/-standard-width/-emphasis-width always; --ds-edge-standard-style/--ds-divider-width/--ds-divider-style only for inset-double). material: 6 (--ds-material-card-texture/-panel-texture/-card-highlight/-overlay-texture/-raised-highlight, --ds-shadow-tint). elevation: 6 (--ds-elevation-1/2/3 via fieldDefaults.elevation, shared with surfaces.elevation-posture's own channels -- plus --ds-elevation-lift-strength/--ds-shadow-key-strength/--ds-shadow-ambient-strength, exclusively this control's own). motif: only 2 (--ds-material-canvas-texture, --ds-page-header-bg) -- 4 of the 7 catalog values (none/dots/deco-fan/ambient-orbs) resolve to NO v1 expansion row at all (source's own documented boundary, K-wave), so they are genuine, universal zero-diff values on every vertical, not a defect.
calibration.coincidentalIdentityExclusionNote: bithire is measured zero-diff on 5 (axis, value) combinations that are NOT its own explicit identity: type/humanist (0 -- IS its identity, excluded above as an identity stop instead), geometry/rounded (0 -- IS its identity), edge/hairline (0), material/flat (0), elevation/hairline-lift (0). The latter three are NOT authored via `expressive.profiles.*` at all -- bithire's own source comment (EXPRESSIVE const, bithire/index.ts:3205-3216) states edge and elevation are DELIBERATELY left unoverridden, inheriting from its selected experience profile ('rottay/bithire-technical@1') instead, which independently resolves to hairline/flat/hairline-lift as ITS OWN baseline. A different class from bithire's own type/geometry identity: this is a sibling control's (experience.profile) resolution coinciding with a value this control's own stops also test, not an authored override of THIS control. None of the 6 receipted stops uses these 3 values for bithire, avoiding the coincidence -- documented rather than silently worked around.
calibration.dbArmBithireExclusionNote: Measured directly (compileTenantThemeConfig, this packet), NOT anticipated by the brief: bithire's DB (tenant-theme) arm shows a genuine, unforced zero-diff on 3 of the 6 chosen regular stops, distinct from the coincidental-identity class above -- `type/editorial` (--ds-select-group-text-transform: editorial: no emitido; geometric: emitido uppercase, resuelto-idéntico al floor incondicional (default.css:759) -- sin movimiento por ambas vías), `material/paper` (--ds-material-card-highlight, same), `motif/contour` (--ds-material-canvas-texture, same) -- while rottay and evnto both move cleanly on the SAME stops, SAME channels, SAME arm. Root cause NOT fully traced (would require reading deeper into the DB compiler's own bithire-specific merge path, out of this packet's read-only measurement scope) -- geometry/pill-accented, edge/outlined and elevation/dramatic all measured moving cleanly for bithire on the DB arm, so this is NOT a whole-vertical DB-arm failure, only these 3 (axis, value, arm) cells, and it is NOT specific to which value is chosen within the affected axis (type failed for two different values). Receipted matrix excludes bithire for type, material and motif (rottay+evnto only, 2 verticals instead of 3 for those three axes) rather than forcing a false witness or silently working around it.
calibration.typeStopValueNote: The type stop was first authored as `geometric` and had to be corrected to `editorial` before receipting (measured, not assumed): `geometric`'s own tableHeader.overlineTransform is `uppercase` (TYPE_PROFILE_ROWS, expressive-profiles/expansion/index.ts), which COINCIDES exactly with `--ds-select-group-text-transform`'s unconditional foundation default (`uppercase`, foundation/themes/default.css:759) -- a causal run measured `moved: false` on rottay for this reason alone, a false non-mover, not a broken door. `editorial` resolves to `none` (different from the foundation default on every vertical, verified directly) and was used instead. The representative-channel swap from --ds-table-header-text-transform to --ds-select-group-text-transform (see fixtures.json's own dated note) is a SEPARATE, unrelated fix -- both channels are real, and this coincidental-default trap applies independently of which of the two is chosen as the declared representative.
calibration.advancedSceneSiblingNote: P3 (Fable, F4B-15 postaudit): the FASE-A advanced-scene construction (`buildIngressInput`, runtime/ingress/index.mjs:731-801) starts from `base = {}` and writes ONLY the one resolved path (`visualFoundation.advanced.profiles.<axis>`) -- confirmed by reading the function AND by a direct in-memory compile of that exact minimal document (compileTenantThemeConfig, no build/Chromium involved), which succeeds with no palette or other sibling required. `visualFoundation.advanced` is a shared container (also holding tokenOverrides, chrome, responsivePosture, per the document schema) and `chrome.cardComponent.bg` is a genuine color field it COULD carry -- but none of this control's own 8 stops ever populate those other advanced-space siblings, so every measured scene is honestly single-field, the same shape as recipe-profile's own (F4B-15). profiles.expressive does not, in practice, exercise a document with a color sibling; it only COULD, by construction of the shared container, which is the distinction this note exists to state precisely.
calibration.catalogLaw: F4B-16 UPDATE: `domain.enumValues` ahora SI existe (28 valores, la union plana deduplicada de los 6 ejes -- ver capabilities/index.ts, comentario junto a `enumValues`) porque es lo unico que hace que domain.kind resuelva a `closed-enum` en vez del `enum` sin reconocer que `ingressValueForStop` no sabe bajar (ver manifest/generator/index.mjs:186). Esa union es CIEGA POR ROL (`enumValues.includes(stop.id)`, runtime/ingress/index.mjs:925, nunca mira A QUE EJE pertenece un valor) -- NO es el verdadero cierre. El catalogo de abajo, por miembro, sigue siendo la UNICA fuente de verdad de que valor es valido para que eje; TenantCapabilityDeclaration.enumValues es `readonly string[]` plano (capabilities/index.ts:47), incapaz de expresar un mapa de ejes por si solo. Mapa de los 7 ejes con vocabulario cerrado propio, copiado literal de packages/core/src/foundation/tokens/ts/presentation/expressive-profiles/index.ts: type :31-36, geometry :39-44, edge :48-54, material :57-63, elevation :67-73, motif :77-85, icon :88-93. ExpressiveAxes declara dos ejes mas, density (:111) y motion (:112-116), que NO entran en este mapa: la fuente dice explicitamente que reusan el vocabulario tenant existente en vez de crear enums de perfil paralelos (:96-101), asi que su dominio lo poseen los controles `density.mode` y `motion.dial`. motif lista los 7 valores ADMITIDOS aunque solo 4 tienen filas de expansion v1: `dots`, `deco-fan` y `ambient-orbs` resuelven y expanden a nada hasta la K-wave (MOTIF_PROFILE_VARIABLES, packages/core/src/foundation/tokens/ts/presentation/expressive-profiles/expansion/index.ts:345-370). El vocabulario admitido es el dominio; la cobertura de expansion es calibracion.
